newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 4.0 bln lire of Italy 18-mo CTZ.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 4.0 bln lire of Italy 18-mo CTZ.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were assigned 4.0 billion lire worth of 18-month zero coupon certificates (CTZ) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 5.85 trillion lire at the open auction for a fifth tranche of the July 15, 1998 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The gross yield was 6.46 percent against 6.20 percent at the previous CTZ sale on February 11.
Specialists also bid for and were assigned 500 million lire worth of two-year CTZ against an offer of 400 billion lire.
At today's auction, the Treasury received bids for 7.14 trillion lire worth of a seventh tranche of the January 15, 1999 paper, against 4.0 trillion lire on offer.
Gross yield was 6.46 percent against a previous 6.17 percent.
